author: faht
body:
Made by Jiveh and Tazz.

As I said in the title, this map is made for the league (https://avicus.net/forums/57ea65e1c) and hopefully for public matches. 

Images: http://imgur.com/a/Yjkws

Loadout:
• Leather helmet
• Leather chestplate
• Leather leggings
• Leather boots
• Stone sword
• Bow
• 8 Steak
• 24 Arrows

Feedback is welcome.
